rationale: Motor vehicle collision with totaled vehicle and bodily injury to the policyholder resulting from impact with another vehicle.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 am yesterday by an oncoming vehicle traveling ~35 mph. Vehicle is totaled with severe structural damage to the trunk. Policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information; $750 deductible applies; $100k coverage limit available.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle traveling at approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: filed; other driver's insurance info included
